Hi Devon —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for HelixHealth's observability rollout. To keep momentum we want to lock owners and a short sprint plan that covers (1) dashboard baselines, (2) trace hook placements, (3) error taxonomy alignment, and (4) alert routing & runbook drafts.

I've attached a lightweight runbook draft and a dashboards spec to start the conversation. Proposed kickoff: week of Oct 26 for a 60-min alignment (technical + stakeholders). Can you confirm who from Helix will be the implementation owner and whether Sonia should be the day-to-day contact? Also flag any blackout dates for the week of Oct 26–30.

High-level internal owners (we'll confirm on the kickoff):
- Technical lead / instrumentation: Ben Carter
- Observability product contact: Laura Bennett
- CS/onboarding lead: Marissa Cole

Next steps: if you confirm owners I will share an owners' action matrix and a short pre-kickoff checklist for Helix devices and environments.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Appreciate the clear ask. Confirming owners: I will be the implementation sponsor and Sonia (cc'd) will be the implementation owner and primary day-to-day. Sonia will own the instrumentation work with our platform engineers.

Week of Oct 26 works but we have a blocker on Oct 27 (quarterly maintenance), so any day other than the 27th is fine. For the kickoff we'd like to invite our Platform PM (I will introduce them after we lock the time).

A couple of clarification items before the kickoff:
- We run both prod-like staging and production; tracing hooks should be validated in staging first — can you confirm you can route traffic-level test traces?
- For dashboards, we prioritise error-rate and tail latency for the first sprint.

I'll defer to Sonia for scheduling.

Thanks — I pulled together an owners' action matrix and a tight 2-week sprint plan below. Attaching an alert-routing diagram (light) and updated runbook draft.

Sprint plan (two 1-week sprints):
Week 1 (instrumentation & baseline):
- Ben (Redwood): validate trace hook placement in staging + provide example trace patterns (2d)
- Sonia (Helix): run synthetic traces and share failing-span samples (2d)
- Laura (Redwood): build baseline dashboards (error-rate, 95/99 latency, request volume) and share read-only link (3d)
- Marissa: coordinate stakeholder invites and acceptance criteria (ongoing)

Week 2 (alerting & runbooks):
- Ben: propose alert thresholds & routing rules based on baselines (2d)
- Laura: draft runbook pages for top 3 alerts (2d)
- Sonia: run instrumentation changes in staging, validate alerts (3d)

Acceptance criteria (demo):
- Dashboards show baseline for the last 7d in staging and prod-simulated traces visible in Redwood UI.
- Alerts trigger in staging and flow to Helix PagerDuty stub.
- Runbook contains steps to acknowledge / escalate and links to traces for diagnosis.

Attachments: alert-routing-diagram.png, runbook-draft.md

I can present this on the kickoff — proposed times: Oct 28 11:00am PT or Oct 29 9:30am PT. Let me know which works.

Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
